title: Best toys for 8-year-olds 2026 UK: LEGO, Nerf and Kindle Kids
seoTitle: Best Toys for 8-Year-Olds 2026 UK: Deals from £9.99
description: The best toys and gifts for 8-year-olds at Black Friday prices: LEGO Knight Bus £29.99, Kindle Kids £89.99, Nerf £21.99 and Exploding Kittens £9.99.
intro:
**The best toy for an 8-year-old this Christmas is the LEGO Harry Potter Knight Bus (76446) at £29.99 on Amazon, well under Hamleys' £44.99. Best cheap pick: Exploding Kittens at £9.99. Best splurge: the Kindle Kids at £89.99, down from £159.99.**

Every price below is Amazon UK's price as listed on PriceSpy on 24 November 2026, during Black Friday Week, with other UK shops for comparison. Prices are moving daily this week, so check the product page before you buy.

deals.name: Exploding Kittens (Original Edition) card game
deals.note: Best cheap pick: a fast, silly card game for ages 7+ that adults enjoy too. Half what Hamleys and Very charge (£19.99).

deals.name: LEGO Speed Champions Back to the Future Time Machine (77256)
deals.note: A quick, satisfying build of the DeLorean. Rated 9+, but fine for a confident 8-year-old builder. A penny off its three-month low; Currys matches.

deals.name: National Geographic Jumbo Glow-in-the-Dark Crystal Growing Kit
deals.note: Grow your own crystals over a week or two, then watch them glow. A good science gift that isn't just another box of bricks.

deals.name: NERF Elite 2.0 Eaglepoint RD-8 blaster
deals.note: An 8-dart blaster with a scope and bipod, rated 8+. The cheapest UK price we found; Amazon's sale price runs until 30 November.

deals.name: LEGO Harry Potter The Knight Bus (76446)
deals.note: Best overall: the purple triple-decker bus with Harry and Stan Shunpike, rated 8+. Currys and Very match; Argos is £31 and Hamleys £44.99.

deals.name: LEGO Technic Fast & Furious Toyota Supra MK4 (42204)
deals.note: A first Technic car for a child who likes seeing how things work. Rated 9+. Argos charges £55 and Hamleys £54.99.

deals.name: VTech KidiZoom Smartwatch DX4 (blue)
deals.note: A kids' watch with two cameras, games and a step counter, and no internet or calls. Other colours cost more, so the blue one is the one to get.

deals.name: LEGO Minecraft The Wither Battle (21590)
deals.note: For Minecraft fans, rated 8+. £15 under Argos, Currys and Hamleys, but Very is £2 cheaper and it has been £29.99 before.

deals.name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 instant camera (Clay White)
deals.note: Prints a credit-card-sized photo in seconds, and it's simple enough for an 8-year-old. Not a big discount, but the cheapest we found; Currys is £69.99. Budget for film.

deals.name: LEGO City Central Train Station (60469)
deals.note: A big station to build onto an existing LEGO City train. Cheapest today, but it was £52.99 in the last three months, so only buy now if it's the main present.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Kids (2024, 16GB, Ocean Explorer)
deals.note: Best splurge: a glare-free e-reader with a kids' cover, a 2-year worry-free guarantee and a year of Amazon Kids+ books. Argos matches. Check you're buying the 2024 model, as the newer 2026 version is £119.99.

body:
## Best toys for 8-year-olds at a glance

- **Best overall:** LEGO Harry Potter The Knight Bus (76446), £29.99 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Exploding Kittens card game, £9.99 at Amazon
- **Best for Minecraft fans:** LEGO Minecraft The Wither Battle (21590), £44.99 at Amazon
- **Best for readers:** Kindle Kids (2024), £89.99 at Amazon
- **Best splurge for creative kids:** Fujifilm Instax Mini 12, £66.05 at Amazon

## What 8-year-olds actually want

By eight, most children have strong opinions. They know which games and films they're into, they can follow long LEGO instructions on their own, and they want things that feel a bit grown-up. The safest gifts tie into something they already love, or let them make or do something real.

- **LEGO for their favourite thing.** Harry Potter, Minecraft and cars are the big ones at this age. Sets marked 8+ or 9+ are the sweet spot: long enough to be a project, short enough to finish on Christmas Day.
- **Games the whole family will play.** Exploding Kittens is quick to learn and works with adults too, which means it actually comes out again after Christmas.
- **A real gadget.** An instant camera or a Kindle feels like a step up from toys. Both are things they'll keep using for years.
- **Science and making.** A crystal kit gives them something to check on every morning, which keeps the excitement going past Boxing Day.

## Is a Kindle Kids worth it for an 8-year-old?

For a child who already reads chapter books, yes. At £89.99 it's £70 off and close to its lowest price. The Kindle Kids is the same e-reader as the standard Kindle, but it comes with a kids' cover, a two-year replacement guarantee if they break it, and a year of Amazon Kids+, which includes thousands of children's books. There are no games or videos, so it doesn't turn into another screen. For older readers in the family, our [Kindle Black Friday deals](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/) page covers the adult models.

If your child prefers listening to reading, audiobooks are a good alternative for car journeys. [Audible](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December, and the Harry Potter audiobooks are a favourite at this age.

## Good prices to aim for

These are taken from PriceSpy's price history this week:

- **LEGO Knight Bus (76446):** around £30 is good; it has dipped to about £27.60.
- **LEGO Speed Champions 77256:** £16 or less is its low.
- **LEGO Technic Supra (42204):** anything under £40 is good; most shops charge £55.
- **LEGO Minecraft Wither Battle (21590):** £44.99 is fair rather than cheap. It has been £29.99, so watch it if you have time.
- **Kindle Kids (2024):** under £90 is a strong price.

Big-name toys usually stay at these prices until Cyber Monday on 30 November, then popular sets can sell out in December. For the main present, buy this week. If you're ordering from Amazon close to Christmas, a [Prime free trial](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) gives you free fast delivery.

For more ideas, see our [best toys for 5-year-olds](/guides/best-toys-for-5-year-olds-2026/), [STEM gifts for kids](/guides/stem-gifts-for-kids/) and [LEGO Black Friday deals](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), or browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What is a good Christmas present for an 8-year-old?

Something linked to what they already love. A LEGO set from their favourite film or game, a family card game, a Kindle for a keen reader or an instant camera for a creative child. Our top pick is the LEGO Harry Potter Knight Bus at £29.99.

### What LEGO is good for an 8-year-old?

Sets marked 8+ or 9+, such as Harry Potter, Minecraft, Speed Champions and the smaller Technic cars. They take an hour or two to build and are designed to be played with afterwards. Sets marked 18+ are display models for adults, even when the theme looks child-friendly.

### How much should I spend on a present for an 8-year-old?

Whatever suits your budget. A £10 card game can get more use than a £70 LEGO set. If several relatives are buying, agree with the parents who's getting what so the big present isn't doubled up.

### Is Exploding Kittens OK for an 8-year-old?

Yes. The original edition is rated 7+ and is just cartoon cats and silly rules. Avoid the NSFW edition, which is for adults only.

### Do 8-year-olds still play with toys?

Most do, but they want toys that feel more grown-up: building sets with real instructions, blasters, gadgets and games. Very young toys and character playsets usually stop getting played with around this age.
